jukeblock.panel.title: Jukeblock
jukeblock.panel.no_source: No media source on this system
jukeblock.config.title: Jukeblock
jukeblock.config.panelColor.tooltip: Background of the rail. Text switches between light and dark automatically to stay readable.
jukeblock.config.panelOpacity.tooltip: How solid the rail is. Lower values let more of the game show through.
jukeblock.config.backdropDim.tooltip: How much the rest of the screen is darkened while the panel is open.
jukeblock.config.railWidth.tooltip: Width in GUI units, not pixels — at GUI scale 4 one unit is four screen pixels. Vanilla's inventory is 176 for reference.
jukeblock.config.smoothAlbumArt.tooltip: Album art arrives at 300x300 and is drawn larger, so without smoothing it looks blocky. Turn off for a crunchier, more pixel-art look.
jukeblock.config.hudMode.tooltip: OFF: never. ON TRACK CHANGE: pops up for a few seconds when the song changes. ALWAYS: stays on screen while something plays.
jukeblock.config.hudCorner.tooltip: Top-left by default — it's the corner vanilla leaves clear. Choose FREE and use the 'Move now-playing HUD' keybind to drag it anywhere.
jukeblock.config.hudToastSeconds.tooltip: Seconds the HUD stays up after a track change.
jukeblock.config.hudOffset.tooltip: For dodging other mods' HUDs. In GUI units.
jukeblock.config.accentFromArt.tooltip: Pull the highlight colour from the current cover. When off, the fixed colour below is used.
jukeblock.config.accentColor.tooltip: Used when 'Accent from album art' is off.
jukeblock.config.adaptAccent.tooltip: Adjusts the accent's brightness so it stays visible against your panel colour — a red cover on a red panel would otherwise disappear. Hue is preserved.
jukeblock.hud.position.title: Position the HUD
jukeblock.hud.position.hint: Drag the box to place the now-playing HUD
jukeblock.hud.position.hint2: Snaps to edges and centre · scroll to resize · ESC when done
